title: archfit upload envelope v2
description: What Action 4 states about one uploaded result. The upload body is the engine's result JSON v1, and payload_digest names its bytes. Every field is self-reported. The decoder is stricter than this document in ways a schema cannot express: integers carry no fraction or exponent and fit 32 bits (run_id 64 bits), keys appear once, and payload_digest must equal the SHA-256 of the body.

event.description: The workflow trigger. Action 4 refuses every other event before it uploads.

pull_request.description: Pull request number; 0 unless event is pull_request.

head_sha.description: The commit the engine checked: the pull request head, the pushed commit, or the merge group commit.

merge_base_sha.description: merge-base(head_sha, target_sha), for every event. On a push to the target branch it equals head_sha.

target_ref.description: The full ref of the target branch the policy was read from, refs/heads/<branch>. Format only: the App compares it with GitHub.

target_sha.description: The target tip the policy was read from, fetched when the run started.

policy_digest.description: sha256:<hex> of the policy file bytes the engine judged with; equal to the result's policy.digest.

payload_digest.description: sha256:<hex> of the exact result bytes of the upload body.
